{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: any row where revenue is 999,999.99 or 999999.99
qa_mask = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[qa_mask]

# Filter for completed orders, excluding QA orders
completed_real = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (~qa_mask)]

# Compute the mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue_real = completed_real['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the values used in evidence
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'Number of real completed orders: {len(completed_real)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue_real}')"}
